patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: After a greasy dinner I got this deep pain under my right ribs that won't let up — it wraps around to my shoulder blade. Makes me nauseous, and it hurts more when I breathe in deep.
presentation.triageNote: 44-year-old female with persistent pain beneath the right ribs after a fatty meal, radiating to the right shoulder blade. She is nauseated and febrile, with marked right-upper-quadrant tenderness that catches her breath on deep palpation.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 3 is appropriate because this stable febrile right-upper-abdominal presentation is expected to require multiple diagnostic and treatment resources.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has persistent postprandial right-upper-quadrant pain, fever, nausea, referred shoulder-blade pain, and inspiratory arrest with palpation.
clinical.acuityReason: The pattern suggests an inflamed biliary process requiring imaging, laboratory testing, medication, and surgical assessment, without current shock or generalized peritonitis.
expectedResources: IV fluids, analgesia, and antiemetic medication
Antibiotics and surgical consultation when confirmed
keyFindings: Radiation to the right shoulder blade
teachingPoints: Persistent pain and fever distinguish an inflammatory process from uncomplicated transient biliary colic.
Hypotension, jaundice with systemic illness, confusion, or generalized peritonitis would increase urgency.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Laboratory testing, ultrasound, symptom control, and antibiotics would likely be followed by surgical consultation and admission.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, hand pressed under her right ribs, guarded
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 44-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: one hand pressed under her right ribs, guarding. Expression: grimacing and nauseated. Clearly visible: a hand pressed under the right rib cage. No text, no logos.
